runtime_footprint: P08 creates no long-running process, image, volume, cache warmer, worker, queue or deployment.
The PostgreSQL proof uses one exact disposable tmpfs container named research-p08-postgres-<pid>; its EXIT trap removes only that container.
Snapshot files are shared content-addressed inputs. Expired preflight metadata may be cleaned actor-scoped and bounded; snapshots referenced by a manifest are never deleted by P08.
An obviously inadmissible study is rejected before snapshot serialization, preventing rejected trial-budget retries from creating unreferenced frames.
prohibited_cleanup: No broad Docker prune, image prune, volume deletion, worktree deletion, HMD/Parquet purge, database vacuum/full rebuild or shared cache cleanup is authorized by P08.
